call_points.text: FY27 revenue growth guided at 25%, with margins similar to FY26.
Employee cost guided at around ₹150 Cr for FY27 after annual increments and one-time bonuses.
FY27 capex: about ₹50 Cr electrolyte/pilot plant spillover plus ₹40-45 Cr maintenance; R&D and land capex not yet quantified.
Indichem plant capex expected to complete by end of this quarter, with revenue from next financial year.
Battery chemicals plant has 4,000 MT total capacity (2,000 MT VC, 2,000 MT FEC), with full utilisation targeted in three years.
CDMO revenue target of ₹1,000 Cr is expected to be beaten, not just met.
Segment margins: Specialty Chemicals around 24%, Pharma around 36%.
Capacity utilisation for the quarter: Sachin 83%, Ankleshwar 23%, Jhagadia 55%.
On CDMO concentration, management said new products will dilute single-molecule dependence but gave no timeline.
Management guided for 25% revenue growth in FY27.
First phase of electrolyte capex is completed, second phase expected by Q1 FY27.
EBITDA margins expected to remain at similar levels in FY27.

operating_notes.text: AAML acquired 75% of South Korean JV Indichem Inc. for approximately ₹190.52 Cr.
Q4FY26 PAT margin was 31.0%, which the company described as its highest ever.
H1 typically contributes around 40% of top line, while H2 accounts for 60% due to seasonality.
Total land area across facilities is 92,835 sq. mtrs with installed capacity of ~1,100 KL.
Acutaas Chemicals Electrolytes Private Limited stake held by Acutaas Chemicals changed from 100% to 90%.
Battery chemicals capacity is 2,000 MT of VC and 2,000 MT of FEC (4,000 MT total), with full utilisation targeted in three years.
Q1FY27 capacity utilisation: Sachin 83%, Ankleshwar 23%, Jhagadia 55%.
Pharma Intermediates was 87% of FY26 revenue and Specialty Chemicals 13%; management expects the Pharma share near 80% in three years.

timeline.summary: Acutaas Chemicals approved a final dividend of ₹2.50 per share and completed a ₹190.52 Cr investment for a 75% stake in Indichem Inc.
Acutaas Chemicals reported Q4FY26 revenue up 40.3% YoY to ₹432.8 Cr and PAT up 114.1% YoY to ₹134.3 Cr, while guiding for 25% revenue growth in FY27.
Board of Directors recommended ₹2.5 final dividend per share (50%) for FY 2025-26, subject to AGM approval on 81,871,122 equity shares.
Acutaas Chemicals Limited shared the earnings call recording held on April 30, 2026, at 5:30 p.m. IST via its website.
Acutaas Chemicals hosted its Q4 FY26 earnings conference call, guiding for 25% revenue growth in FY27.
Acutaas Chemicals released its corporate investor presentation detailing capacity, business segments, and ongoing capex.
Acutaas Chemicals diluted its stake in subsidiary ACEPL from 100% to 90% following a preferential allotment of shares to A.R.Z Pharma.
Acutaas Chemicals completed the acquisition of Enchem Ami Organics Private Limited to make it a direct wholly-owned subsidiary on October 17, 2026.
Recording of Acutaas Chemicals Limited's earnings call held on 27 October 2026 at 4:00 p.m. IST is available on the company website.
